Every release of Biryar is listed here, newest first, with what changed in
plain words. Updating is free on both plans and takes about a minute.

## How to update

Open a terminal in your `biryar` folder, the one that holds
`docker-compose.yml`, and type these two lines, one after the other:

```
docker compose pull
docker compose up -d
```

The first downloads the newest release. The second restarts Biryar on it.
Then reload Biryar in your browser.

**Your data is not touched.** Your sales, costs, deals, decisions,
settings and keys stay exactly as they were. Biryar brings its own
database up to date as it starts, and an update that fails changes
nothing and says why.

## Which version do I have?

Open **Help** in Biryar and look under **About Biryar**. It says "This is
version" followed by the number. Compare it with the first heading below.
Releases before 0.1.2 do not show their number; if yours shows none, it
is older than 0.1.2.

## How do I know there is a new one?

By looking at this page. Biryar does not check for updates by itself,
because it contacts nobody but Amazon, Keepa and your shops, and that
includes us. If you bought a licence, we also write to you when a release
matters to you.

## 0.1.2, 11 November 2026

**One extra step for this release.** If you installed before 11 November
2026 and want to add a retailer of your own, download `docker-compose.yml`
again before the two update lines, with the same line you installed with
(see [Install](/setup/install/#run-it)). The older file kept the folder
for your own retailers read-only. Nothing else needs it, and your data is
not affected.

Sourcing:

- Every shop now says under its name whether it **needs ScraperAPI** or
  needs **no key**.
- **Medimops** is included, which makes eighteen shops.
- **Shops that run by themselves** get their passes spread evenly over the
  day, from 1 to 48 a day. The schedule has a **Save changes** button, and
  the Sourcing page shows first what is running, what is waiting its turn
  and when each shop is next due.
- **What a schedule costs** in Keepa tokens is shown while you set it,
  against what your Keepa plan refills, with a suggestion when it is too
  much.
- When your **ScraperAPI credits are used up**, Biryar says exactly that
  and no longer blames the shop. It tries again every hour and carries on
  by itself.
- Every deal has a **Keepa** link beside its Shop and Amazon links, and
  shows how many sell a day.
- A running scan has a **Stop it** button, and a shop that fails three
  pages in a row is given up for that scan with the reason shown.
- A retailer you add yourself under Settings is now saved properly.

Repricing:

- **Prices are now applied on Amazon.** In 0.1.1, with Pro and sending
  switched on, Amazon refused every price Biryar sent, because of a fault
  in how it was sent. If you switched sending on and saw nothing change,
  this was why.
- A pass starts at its scheduled time, to the minute, and each scheduled
  time runs once.
- Repricing **no longer waits behind a Sourcing scan**, and the page says
  "Queued" when a pass is waiting its turn.
- After a price is sent, Biryar waits until Amazon shows it, and the
  price it shows for a listing is the one buyers see.

Installing and signing in:

- **A forgotten password** is one line that asks who you are, with a page
  that explains it: [Getting back in](/setup/getting-back-in/).
- **The setup code** line on the sign-up page now works when typed on
  your own computer.
- After the computer restarts, Biryar **waits for its database** and
  starts by itself.
- **Connecting Amazon**: the form says where each of the four values is
  found, links to the guide, and refuses a marketplace ID typed in place
  of your merchant token.
- **Help** shows which version you run, and has a button to open Biryar
  as an app with its own icon.

## 0.1.1, 10 November 2026

- A licence that ends within two weeks is announced on the Home page.
- The repricer can be parked: under Settings, Repricing, choose **Only
  when I start one**, and every listing keeps its switch.
- The install lines for Windows.

## 0.1.0, 10 November 2026

The first release: Sourcing, Repricing and Portfolio, the Free and Pro
plans, and sign-in with a password and a code from your phone.
